AN ORDINANCE TO PROVIDE FOR PARK RULES AND REGULATIONS, PERTAINING TO THAT PORTION OF LAND LOCATED IN PARCEL # 12 064A 02 002; 12 064A 02 003; 12 064A 02 004; 12 064A 02 005; 12 064A 02 006; 12 064A 02 007; 12 064A 02 008; OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CLAY E. GAILEY PARK; TO PROVIDE FOR ENFORCEMENT; TO PROVIDE FOR PENALTIES FOR FAILING TO COMPLY WITH OR VIOLATING THE ORDINANCE; TO PROVIDE FOR ALL MATTERS RELATIVE TO THE FOREGOING; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

WHEREAS, it is necessary to protect the Clay E. Gailey Park for the use, safety and welfare of the general public;

WHEREAS, the Town of Clermont under the constitutional authority of Article IX, Section II, Paragraph 3 of the Georgia Constitution of 1983 has the authority to adopt ordinances exercising authority over parks, recreational areas, programs, and facilities; and : | |

WHEREAS, the Town of. Clermont, by and “through its governing authority, the Mayor and Council for the Town of Clermont, to accomplish ‘the purposes recited herein enacts the following:

DEFINITIONS For the purposes of this Ordinance, certain words in the singular number shall include the plural number and words in the plural number shall include the singular number unless the obvious construction of the wording indicates

otherwise.

The word "shall" is mandatory.

For the purposes of this Ordinance the Clay E. Gailey Park shall be defined as all that piece or parcel of land located in Parcel # 12 064A 02 002; 12 064A 02 003; 12 064A 02 004; 12 064A 02 005; 12 064A 02 006; 12 064A 02 007; 12 064A 02 008.

PROHIBITED ACTS No person shall cut, remove or destroy any tree, sapling, seedling, brush or shrub whether alive or dead, or chip, blaze, box, girdle, trim or otherwise deface or injure any tree or shrub or break or remove any branch, foliage, flower or any tree or shrub or pick, gather, uproot, remove or destroy any flower, plant or grass. No person shall remove or cause to be removed any sod, sand, earth, humus, peat, rocks, boulders or gravel. No person shall build, light or maintain any open or outdoor fire at any place within the Park except in areas or facilities provided and designated for this purpose. No person shall possess while on Park property a revolver, pistol, shotgun, rifle, air rifle, air gun, or any gun or bow or other weapons that discharge projectiles either by air, explosive substances or any other force. No person shall discharge or set off anywhere on Park property any explosives, revolver, pistol, shotgun, rifle, air rifle, or any bow, or other weapons that discharge projectiles either by air, explosive substance or any other force. No person shall possess or consume alcoholic beverages while on Park property.

No person shall cause a disturbance or engage in any activity which shall unreasonably interfere with the use and enjoyment of the Park by citizens, including the use of vulgar, profane or abusive language.

No person shall deface in any way the benches, fences, or other structures in the Park.

No person shall deposit trash or refuse matter of any kind therein.

No person shall violate any ordinance or law of the

City or State.

No person shall climb over or under the Park’s fence, to gain entry to the Park at any time.

No person shall be inside the fenced area of the Park when the gates to the Park are locked.

There shall be no bikes inside the fenced area, unless they are placed in the bike rack.

There shall be no skateboards inside the Park.

No person shall possess a hardball or softball inside the Park.

There shall be no pets inside the fenced area of the Park, with the exception of seeing eye dogs accompanying the blind.

There shall be no motorized vehicles of any kind inside the fenced area of the Park, except vehicles, mowers, etc. owned by the City of Clermont and operated by employees of the City Council.

There shall be no one above the age of ten (10)

inside the playground area of the Park where the sand is located, except for parent(s) attending a child. There shall be no food or drinks in the playground area of the Park where. the sand is located.

There shall be no’ other activity, other than the sport of tennis, conducted on the tennis court.

No person shall destroy, break or damage any public property. |

No person shall climb on any building within the Park.

City reserves the right to close the Park at such times as may be deemed in the best interest of the public, for mowing, spraying, construction and repairs and for other activities which may pose a threat to the safety of the public. The hours of operation shall be as follows: May - October: 8:00 a.m. — 10:00 p.m.

November - April: 8:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m.
5:
It shall be unlawful for any person to violate or fail to comply with any provision of this Ordinance. Violation of any provision of this Ordinance, not covered by local or state law, shall be punishable by a fine not exceeding One Thousand Dollars ($1,000.00) or imprisonment for a term not exceeding six (6) months or by both such fine and imprisonment. Each day any violation of any provision of this Ordinance occurs or continues shall constitute 4a separate offense.

HOURS OF OPERATION No person, except authorized city employees, shall enter or remain within the confines of the Park area, except during the stated hours of operation unless a public meeting is held which has been authorized by the City Council. The
